Lines: Orobas: Big machine!! It moves! Someone inside?!
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Hey, stay back! That's an axe!
Orobas: An axe?! Dangerous, very dangerous!
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Put it away, Ryoma. He just wants a look.
[white]Hayato[/white]: Benkei's right. The loudspeaker's on, Ryoma. You don't have to shout.
Orobas: Three voices! Louder and louder!! Loud!

Option: [red]Ryoma[/red]: Look all you want. Keep away from the axe.
Lines: [red]Ryoma[/red]: Look all you want. Keep away from the axe.
Orobas: Ryoma's scary!! Axe is scary too! What can I look at?!
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Behind us. Those black wings. Look like a bat's, don't they?
Orobas: Wings! Black wings!! Can it fly?!
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Of course. Shin Getter One doesn't just run along the ground.
Orobas: High?! Can you see far, far away?!
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Ha! You know where to look. Next time I'll tell you what's up there.

Option: [red]Ryoma[/red]: Those black wings we talked about. I used to fly a Black Getter, alone.
Lines: [red]Ryoma[/red]: Those black wings we talked about. I used to fly a Black Getter, alone.
Orobas: Black again! Alone?! Nobody to talk to?!
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Nice and quiet. Flew wherever I pleased.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: You still never let us finish a sentence.
Orobas: What did you see?! Far away! Not fighting!
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Fallen buildings. Broken roads. People still walking through the ruins.
Orobas: Houses fallen... people still walking?!
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Yeah. Daylight was still there. Had to keep going.
Orobas: People so small, so strong! Good story! Good story!

Option: [red]Ryoma[/red]: Want another story? No fighting this time.
Lines: [red]Ryoma[/red]: Want another story? No fighting this time.
Orobas: Yes! Yes!! Ryoma remembered!
[red]Ryoma[/red]: It's blindingly bright ahead. I'll tell you about it when I'm back.
Orobas: The Architect?! Architect isn't bad! Talk, talking is good!
[red]Ryoma[/red]: We'll see when we meet. You're not even asking if I win? Just the sights?
Orobas: Fighting hurts! Nobody comes back, who tells stories?!
[red]Ryoma[/red]: ...All right. Wait for me. I still owe you one.
Orobas: Waiting! Orobas will wait!

Option: [white]Hayato[/white]: Are you looking at the machine, or at us?
Lines: [white]Hayato[/white]: Are you looking at the machine, or at us?
Orobas: You're looking at Orobas! Orobas looks at you too!
[white]Hayato[/white]: Hayato Jin. Now you know what to call me.
Orobas: Hayato! The one with lots of questions!
[white]Hayato[/white]: Hmph. You can tell by the voice alone.
Orobas: Crowded inside?! Three people, how do you fit?!
[white]Hayato[/white]: We each have a seat. Though someone keeps taking over everyone else's channel.
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Who are you talking about?

Option: [white]Hayato[/white]: Is that scorch mark what you're hiding from?
Lines: Orobas: Stop! That black bit... infected?! [jitter]The Blight is back?![/jitter]
[white]Hayato[/white]: That's scorched armor. What's this Blight you're talking about?
Orobas: Bad stuff! Had to hide before, hide so long!
[white]Hayato[/white]: You waited until it disappeared before coming out?
Orobas: Yes! Gone, then out! But black like that, looks like...
[white]Hayato[/white]: The scorch hasn't changed. You can look from there.
Orobas: Don't have to come closer? Really?!
[white]Hayato[/white]: Of course. Charging ahead without knowing what frightens you isn't courage.
Orobas: Hayato gets scared too?! Ask more next time!

Option: [white]Hayato[/white]: You wanted to explore, but feared the Blight. Still going forward today?
Lines: [white]Hayato[/white]: You wanted to explore, but feared the Blight. Still going forward today?
Orobas: Yes! Want to see!! Hayato not scared?!
[white]Hayato[/white]: I am. Scared of mistaking what I don't know for something I do.
Orobas: Then what?! Stop looking?!
[white]Hayato[/white]: Check the way back. Take one step forward. If something's wrong, retreat.
Orobas: One step... one look! Another step!
[white]Hayato[/white]: Hmph. Quick learner.
Orobas: Look together?! Friend with many questions!
[white]Hayato[/white]: Let's go. You lead this time.

Option: [yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Steady now. Let me reach down there.
Lines: Orobas: Dropped it!! Down there! Don't want that one!!
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Steady now. Let me reach down there.
Orobas: Don't want it! Got others!! Don't want it!
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Ha ha! Good as ever. Catch!
Orobas: Benkei! Big hands! So gentle!!
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Practice from looking after children. Brute strength won't do for that.
Orobas: Children?! Can they drive big machines?!
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Kei... ah... she only started piloting Getter later.

Option: [yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: You still remember that story about the kid.
Lines: Orobas: Story about the child!! Benkei didn't finish!!
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: You remember, huh? She's Kei. As a little one, Genki. Thirteen years went by looking after her.
Orobas: Thirteen years!! Long?!
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Doesn't feel like it day by day. Meals, sleep, getting home safe. Always something to do.
Orobas: Then! Then what?!
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Then she became a pilot too. I said she could do it, but my fists still clenched when she left.
Orobas: Pull her back?!
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Wanted to. But seeing that kid take the controls... heh, she really was a pilot.
Orobas: Orobas has stories too!! Next time Orobas tells!

Option: [yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Your turn today. I'm listening.
Lines: [yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Your turn today. I'm listening.
Orobas: Orobas came from a tree!! [green]An Ancient Tree!![/green] Not just Orobas!!
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Want to start with your own tree?
Orobas: Tree grows! What's inside grows!! Different places, different trees, different us!!
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: No wonder there's so much you want to see. Leave home, and everything's new.
Orobas: Benkei left child!! To look too?!
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Yeah. I've got to move forward too. Still time to rest here a little, though.
Orobas: Then rest! Rest!! Orobas finds things to show you this time!
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Ha! Now you're looking after me.
Orobas: Ryoma!! Hayato!! Benkei!! So long!! Counted! Nobody missing!!
[white]Hayato[/white]: Not testing how many of us there are this time?
Orobas: No test!! Stories test!!
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Settle down, then. No need to rush through them today.
[red]Ryoma[/red]: I've got a fight worth telling you about!
Orobas: Sights first! Want to hear! Want to hear!
Orobas: Ryoma won! Ryoma won! This time?!
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Which part do you want first?
Orobas: Bright things!! Far things!! Things that come back!!
[white]Hayato[/white]: That covers more every time.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: The last one's right in front of you.
Orobas: Right!! All three here!!
Orobas: Back! But last time... hurt badly?! Where hurts?!
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Still standing. Next time I'll knock that bastard flat.
Orobas: Fight again?! Hurt again! Sit first, here!
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: All right, all right. We'll sit. Look, all three of us came back.
Orobas: Three... all here! Stories later!
[white]Hayato[/white]: Yeah. We'll sit with you today.
Orobas: Orobas asks today!!
[white]Hayato[/white]: When have you ever not asked?
Orobas: First this time!!
[red]Ryoma[/red]: You're already talking first.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Go on, ask.
Orobas: ...Can't remember!! You tell first!!
Tanx: Too weak!! But potential!! Take a weapon!
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Ha! Challenging us already? Straight to the point!
Tanx: Inside the iron thing!! All three at once!
[white]Hayato[/white]: Ryoma, look at his stance first.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Unit Three is ready too. If it's strength he wants, I'm not hanging back!
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Hear that? That's the Getter Team!

Option: [red]Ryoma[/red]: The axe stays there. The man in front of you is Ryoma Nagare!
Lines: Tanx: Ryoma!! Still haven't sharpened that axe?!
[red]Ryoma[/red]: The axe stays there. The man in front of you is Ryoma Nagare!
Tanx: Out of the tin can?! So small, still glaring at me!
[red]Ryoma[/red]: What, need to measure me before you dare take me on?
Tanx: Ha ha!! That's the look! Bring your iron thing!
[red]Ryoma[/red]: All right! Once I've checked this ground, I'll show you Getter's power!
Tanx: I'll wait!! Bring the other two voices!

Option: [red]Ryoma[/red]: Flying alone, at least nobody talked back.
Lines: Tanx: Three again!! Ryoma, afraid to come alone?!
[red]Ryoma[/red]: I flew Black Getter alone! There's nothing I haven't fought through!
Tanx: Then why bring them?!
[white]Hayato[/white]: Probably needs someone to point out the enemy behind him.
[red]Ryoma[/red]: That desperate to steal my prey?
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Ha ha! In front, behind, why not take them all together!
Tanx: Good!! Even louder this time!
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Three men together have more than loud voices!

Option: [red]Ryoma[/red]: Tanx! Time to keep that promise!
Lines: [red]Ryoma[/red]: Tanx! Time to keep that promise!
Tanx: Ha ha!! Finally showing your real strength!
[white]Hayato[/white]: Area clear. Ryoma, just this one strike.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Holding steady here. Let him have it!
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Catch this! [b]Getter Tomahawk![/b]
Tanx: Good!! That's an axe blow! Again!
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Ha ha ha! That's the stuff! Next time, catch an even harder one!

Option: [white]Hayato[/white]: When you call for a fight, your tail moves first.
Lines: [white]Hayato[/white]: When you call for a fight, your tail moves first.
Tanx: Where's your weapon!! Why hide it!!
[white]Hayato[/white]: Hmph. You were looking right at it.
Tanx: ...Your eyes?!
[white]Hayato[/white]: All those blades are just extra iron to carry if you can't spot an opening.
Tanx: Ha!! Next time, tail doesn't move first!!

Option: [white]Hayato[/white]: Seeing one opening isn't enough.
Lines: Tanx: Tail didn't move today!! What are you looking at!
[white]Hayato[/white]: Your next step. Your tail isn't the only thing that leaves an opening.
Tanx: See it, charge! What are you waiting for!
[white]Hayato[/white]: Combining is the same. If my signal's late, those other two have to stake their lives on it.
Tanx: Then shout louder!
[white]Hayato[/white]: Hmph. Loud nonsense won't save anyone. What matters is those two trusting me with their lives.
Tanx: They listen to you that much?!
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Like hell! You screw up, I'll be the first to drag you back!
[white]Hayato[/white]: Hear that? That's how it works.

Option: [white]Hayato[/white]: No need to count to three. You're already about to move.
Lines: Tanx: One!! Two—
[white]Hayato[/white]: No need to count to three. You're already about to move.
Tanx: You always spoil the fun!!
[white]Hayato[/white]: Not satisfied? Try again.
Tanx: ...Ha ha! Good!! Next time I'll wait until four!!
[white]Hayato[/white]: Hmph. You've just told me.
Tanx: [b]Damn it!![/b] Next time I won't tell!!

Option: [yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Benkei Kuruma, Shin Getter Three! For a test of strength, you've found your man!
Lines: Tanx: A sturdy one now!! Big yellow fellow! Charge!
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Benkei Kuruma, Shin Getter Three! For a test of strength, you've found your man!
Tanx: What are you waiting for!
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Those weapons underfoot. Crush them, and you've got nobody to complain to.
Tanx: Clear them!! Clear everything!
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Ha ha! Good! Next time, leave us room for a throw!

Option: [yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Here you come! Just the charge I was waiting for!
Lines: Tanx: All clear this time!! Benkei, catch me!
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Here you come! Just the charge I was waiting for!
Tanx: Why back away?! Scared!
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Now! Secret technique—[b]Daisetsuzan [yellow]Oroshi![/yellow][/b]
Tanx: Whoa?! ...Ha ha ha! You actually threw me down!
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Charge straight ahead, and you leave your whole back to me!
Tanx: Again! Watching your hands this time!
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Get up first! You'll remember that one for a while!

Option: [yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Oh, watching both my hands now?
Lines: [yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Oh, watching both my hands now?
Tanx: That throw! Not getting me this time!
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Keep an eye on the other two as well. We're a team!
Tanx: You shield them, I hit you first!
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Come on, then! When it's my turn to be the shield, nobody gets past me!
[red]Ryoma[/red]: That's the spirit, Benkei!
Tanx: Ha ha!! All three together, I'll remember!
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: And I'll be ready next time!
Tanx: Finally!! Ryoma!! Tail won't move first this time!!
[white]Hayato[/white]: That was my advice.
Tanx: Remember everything!! Benkei! Watching your hands too!!
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Good! I'll see if you've planted your feet.
[red]Ryoma[/red]: All this time, and you still haven't settled down.
Tanx: You reached the top last time!! My turn now!!
[red]Ryoma[/red]: When don't you say that?
[white]Hayato[/white]: His spirit has never lost, at least.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Ha ha! We'll give him a proper demonstration next time!
Tanx: [b]Good!! All three of you, nobody missing!![/b]
Tanx: Lost and still came back!! Good!!
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Ha! You make it sound like you beat us!
[white]Hayato[/white]: We won't leave the same opening twice.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Right! This time, I'll take the front!
Tanx: Ha ha!! Better than 'I surrender'!!
Tanx: One!! Two!! Five!!
[white]Hayato[/white]: You missed two.
Tanx: Keep you guessing!!
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Didn't guess that, I'll admit.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: ...Maybe practice counting first?
Vakuu: A splendid contract. Which of you three will sign for the other two?
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Think a scrap of paper lets you order us around?
[white]Hayato[/white]: It's blank, Ryoma. He's even saved himself the bait.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Let me see, Hayato... hey, you expect us to sign this?
Vakuu: And your name, cautious big fellow?
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Benkei Kuruma. You can have the name. Take your paper back!

Option: [red]Ryoma[/red]: You're staring at my fists. What are you planning?
Lines: [red]Ryoma[/red]: You're staring at my fists. What are you planning?
Vakuu: I could find you an enemy worthy of your hatred.
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Want me to settle your own grudge for you?
Vakuu: An angry man always needs direction.
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Enough talk. Keep pointing fingers, and you're next.
Vakuu: ...Good. At least you won't bore me.

Option: [red]Ryoma[/red]: Even that hell couldn't keep me locked up!
Lines: Vakuu: That anger is still burning. Who drove you to such a state?
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Someone framed me and threw me in prison. But even that hell couldn't keep me locked up!
Vakuu: Avenger. Such a fitting name. I could give you power—
[red]Ryoma[/red]: I crawled out of hell to drag that bastard down there with my own hands!
Vakuu: With your hands alone? You could become something far stronger—
[red]Ryoma[/red]: A puppet? Ha! I broke hell's chains, and now you want to give me new ones?
Vakuu: Rejecting even a demon's kindness. Such a stubborn creature.
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Then remember this: you don't get to swing my fists!

Option: [red]Ryoma[/red]: Who do you want me to kill for you this time?
Lines: [red]Ryoma[/red]: Who do you want me to kill for you this time?
Vakuu: The Architect. For once, our wishes might coincide.
[red]Ryoma[/red]: If he blocks my way, I'll take him down.
Vakuu: See? We have so little to disagree about.
[red]Ryoma[/red]: But if you take his place and start giving orders, I'll take you down too!
Vakuu: ...Must you always speak so unpleasantly?
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Making sure you understand!
Vakuu: Heh heh heh. Interesting. Very interesting.

Option: [white]Hayato[/white]: There aren't even any terms on this.
Lines: [white]Hayato[/white]: There aren't even any terms on this.
Vakuu: Sign first. We can discuss the terms at our leisure.
[white]Hayato[/white]: You first.
Vakuu: Why would I—
[white]Hayato[/white]: Hmph. Your words. Sign first, then talk.
Vakuu: A cunning soul. At least tell me your name.
[white]Hayato[/white]: Hayato Jin. Remember it with your ears. No paper needed.

Option: [white]Hayato[/white]: You're rather sparing with the part you have to fulfill.
Lines: Vakuu: Every line is filled this time. Surely you're satisfied?
[white]Hayato[/white]: I risk my life, you give me power. That's it?
Vakuu: Admirably concise. And generous.
[white]Hayato[/white]: How much? When? You're rather sparing with the part you have to fulfill.
Vakuu: Naturally, interpretation belongs to the one who understands contracts best.
[white]Hayato[/white]: I see. Since you understand so well, you'll sign on my side.
Vakuu: ...Where have you written my name?
[white]Hayato[/white]: Nowhere yet. The pen's in your hand. Why have you stopped?
Vakuu: [jitter]Put the paper down.[/jitter] Today's business is concluded.

Option: [white]Hayato[/white]: So desperate to find someone to die for you. Who did you cross?
Lines: [white]Hayato[/white]: So desperate to find someone to die for you. Who did you cross?
Vakuu: The Architect! This Spire should have been mine! He returned to life and ruined my [jitter]face[/jitter]!
[white]Hayato[/white]: Hmph. Finally, the truth. Could have spared us those last two conversations.
Vakuu: Now you know. We'll speak alone. Your companions needn't interfere.
[white]Hayato[/white]: Without them here, I'd have to watch that pen even more closely.
Vakuu: Have you no ambition?
[white]Hayato[/white]: I do. Just no plans to fulfill yours.

Option: [yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Kei. My daughter. What of it?
Lines: Vakuu: You were holding that photograph so tightly. Your daughter?
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Kei. My daughter. What of it?
Vakuu: How many years does raising a child cost? She must be very obedient.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Ha ha! If she were, I'd have a lot less to worry about.
Vakuu: After all you've given her, a little obedience is hardly too much to ask.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Stop counting! I raised a daughter, not someone who owes me money!
Vakuu: ...Fathers never enjoy the truth.

Option: [yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: First, tell me what you want to take from her!
Lines: Vakuu: If I could keep Kei safe forever, what would you say?
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: First, tell me what you want to take from her!
Vakuu: Merely her father's signature. Isn't shielding your child your duty?
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Of course I'll stand in front of her. But that paper of yours is aimed at her!
Vakuu: One chance only. Refuse, and the next time she's in danger—
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Her old man will bear it! You've got no right to question a father's decision!
Vakuu: Courage cannot guarantee her safety.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: At least these hands won't deliver her to a demon!

Option: [yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: She's been able to pilot on her own for a long time. I know it, even if I don't say it.
Lines: Vakuu: Getting angry for your daughter again? She'll leave you one day.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: She's been able to pilot Getter on her own for a long time. I know it, even if I don't say it.
Vakuu: Then why all this anxiety?
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: See her rush out, and I still want to pull her back. Guess I'll never shake that habit.
Vakuu: I could make her stay forever—
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Enough! If she wants to fly, let her fly. I'll watch her back!
Vakuu: And you gain nothing.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Seeing her come home is plenty. A demon like you could spend a lifetime and never work that out!
Vakuu: It's been a while. Not a single signature, yet three names to remember.
[white]Hayato[/white]: Hmph. Knowing our names won't make us obey.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: No need to keep thinking about my daughter either.
[red]Ryoma[/red]: You can keep thinking about my fists.
Vakuu: ...You really haven't forgotten a thing.
Vakuu: Come, let us celebrate the last victory.
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Our victory. Put the glass down.
[white]Hayato[/white]: If it's a celebration, stick to that. Your pen seems rather busy.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Ha ha! Caught you!
Vakuu: A pity. Winning hasn't made you any easier to fool.
Vakuu: Didn't even reach the Architect last time, did you? I could lower my price today.
[white]Hayato[/white]: You'd be setting the price again?
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Thinking about my daughter again?
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Still haven't given that up!
Vakuu: ...I haven't finished.
[red]Ryoma[/red]: We've heard enough.
Vakuu: No contracts today. Satisfied?
[white]Hayato[/white]: That roll under the table is for wiping your hands, then?
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Ha ha! Saves us searching!
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Hide it as deep as you like. You won't fool him.
Vakuu: Three familiar customers who know how to spoil an evening.
Darv: Whoa! What forgotten age did that big fellow march out of?!
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Still kicking! Got anything good enough for Shin Getter?
Darv: Yes! Certainly! Now where did I put it...
[white]Hayato[/white]: Ryoma, that box is moving. Benkei, watch the mount.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: You watch the box, Hayato. I've got this. Hey, mind its feet!
Darv: Benkei? Just the strength I need! Hold that up, keep holding!

Option: [red]Ryoma[/red]: You can look. Shin Getter isn't for sale.
Lines: Darv: Ryoma! If your big fellow could spare just a little piece—
[red]Ryoma[/red]: You can look. Shin Getter isn't for sale.
Darv: Didn't say buying! Borrowing it for a couple of days would do!
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Did you return the last thing you said that about?
Darv: Oh, remembering so much must be exhausting!
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Hmph. Then I might forget how hard I'm hitting you!

Option: [red]Ryoma[/red]: I piloted a Black Getter too. Hey, that price tag came out fast!
Lines: [red]Ryoma[/red]: I piloted a Black Getter too. Hey, that price tag came out fast!
Darv: A black one as well! Where is it? Did you bring it?
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Mention it once, and you're already asking where it is.
[red]Ryoma[/red]: When I flew it back alone, I wasn't thinking of leaving a pretty shell for people to admire.
Darv: Something that's been used has a history! Tell me, tell me!
[red]Ryoma[/red]: We nearly gave everything getting through. Think your shiny trinkets could buy that?

Option: [red]Ryoma[/red]: Oh? Want Shin Getter in your display again?
Lines: [red]Ryoma[/red]: Oh? Want Shin Getter in your display again?
Darv: It's a display... a space for a valued customer!
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Leave me a way out.
Darv: If everything leaves, what happens to my collection?
[red]Ryoma[/red]: You're not keeping us here to rust!
Darv: Then promise you'll visit when you pass through!
[red]Ryoma[/red]: If you're still here when I get back.

Option: [white]Hayato[/white]: Why can't we touch that one?
Lines: Darv: Pick from this pile! Not that one, haven't figured it out yet!
[white]Hayato[/white]: Why can't we touch that one?
Darv: Oh, don't trouble yourself. Look at this, shiny!
[white]Hayato[/white]: Who left that other piece?
Darv: Left it... well, things need somewhere to stay.
[white]Hayato[/white]: Things, or their owners?
Darv: Next time! Once I find where I wrote it down, I'll tell you!

Option: [white]Hayato[/white]: Find where you wrote it down?
Lines: [white]Hayato[/white]: Find where you wrote it down?
Darv: Look at this first. Fine thing from an old age. Never met anyone who could fix it.
[white]Hayato[/white]: Broken is one thing. Still remember its name and where it came from?
Darv: Its old home may not exist anymore. You think I haven't seen that happen?
[white]Hayato[/white]: That's why I'm asking you. When you forget too, who can anyone ask?
Darv: I can barely remember where the goods are, and you want another ledger.
[white]Hayato[/white]: I'll write a couple of lines for you. Fixing a machine takes longer.

Option: [white]Hayato[/white]: Is your own origin packed in a box too?
Lines: Darv: Wrote down where it came from. Don't ask what script I used!
[white]Hayato[/white]: Is your own origin packed in a box too?
Darv: A tree! [green]Ancient Trees[/green] grow differently, and so do those who come out. Not like your papers, flattened and stacked.
[white]Hayato[/white]: Heh. I understand the trees. I'd like to hear what happened after you left yours.
Darv: ...You're looking at it. Riding my old friend toward more treasures.
[white]Hayato[/white]: See? You can tell it perfectly well. Prices are when you start talking in circles.
Darv: Enough! The man asking names should look at the goods too!

Option: [yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Not trading this. Musashi left it behind.
Lines: Darv: Hey, let me see that old bundle you're carrying!
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Not trading this. Musashi left it behind.
Darv: An old acquaintance? Shame it's so worn. Keep carrying it, and it'll break.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Musashi's gone. I want to keep this close.
Darv: All the more reason to preserve it! Boxes, lining, nobody stores things better than I do!
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Lock it in a box, then leave it in a corner even you can't find?
Darv: Hey! I remember my treasures!
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Then remember this. It belonged to the man who came before me—Musashi Tomoe.

Option: [yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Rough road. Time to change the wrapping too.
Lines: Darv: Still carrying Musashi's piece? Look, another scrape!
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Yeah. Rough road. Time to change the wrapping too.
Darv: Something so precious belongs somewhere safe. What's the point of preserving it if it gets battered with you!
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: When he was alive, he never spent a day hiding in the rear.
Darv: But an object isn't a person! Break it, and it won't walk back on its own!
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: ...You're right about that. Show me some sturdy lining.
Darv: That's the way! Then I'll find a box—
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Just the cloth. Wrap it properly, and I'll still take it with me.

Option: [yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Looks like neither of us will convince the other.
Lines: Darv: Wrapped it well this time. Still say a box would be safer.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: And I still want it with me. Looks like neither of us will convince the other.
Darv: Someone has to keep old things. You all charge ahead; what's left when you look back?
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: ...Yeah. If nobody cared enough to keep them, that would hurt too.
Darv: Then you'll let me have Musashi's—
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Not this one! Ha ha, you never miss an opening!
Darv: All right, all right. Then I'll wait for you to bring its story back. Fair?
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Fair. You guard these treasures. I'll take him a little farther.
Darv: Long time! Benkei, wrapping still holding?
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Sure is! No shortage of useful little things in this Spire.
[white]Hayato[/white]: And the origins of those old pieces? Where did you write them this time?
Darv: I remembered! Straight to questions, like an inspection!
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Ha ha! Your treasures haven't buried you yet.
Darv: Made it through?! Brought the old things back too!
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Yeah. Musashi's piece is safe too.
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Shin Getter's still going. Save the display for someone else.
Darv: I know, I know! What did you see on the way?
[white]Hayato[/white]: Wanting the story first. That's new.
Darv: Didn't finish last time? Here, all the sturdy things!
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Good! Let's pick something to hit back hard with!
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: More wrapping too. Got to look after what travels with us.
Darv: That's my specialty! Look at the stitching!
[white]Hayato[/white]: Take your time. Ask what it's for before choosing.
Darv: Found an empty box today. Fine thing!
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Empty, and you can still sing its praises?
Darv: Anything fits inside! Rarer than a full one!
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Hayato, is he planning to collect air too?
[white]Hayato[/white]: If you'll pay for it.
Darv: Hey! Some things aren't for sale!
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Ha ha! Finally got you to say it!
Pael: [thinky_dots]...Hhh...[/thinky_dots]
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Talking or snoring?
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Keep it down, Ryoma.
[white]Hayato[/white]: Watch your step, Benkei. Wait. He's still speaking.
Pael: Take... just... a little...
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: All right. We're listening.
[red]Ryoma[/red]: ...Hayato, sure he hasn't fallen asleep?

Option: [red]Ryoma[/red]: Hey, you must be awake by now!
Lines: [red]Ryoma[/red]: Hey, you must be awake by now!
Pael: [thinky_dots]Before you spoke... already awake...[/thinky_dots]
[red]Ryoma[/red]: ...Am I that loud?
Pael: Yes.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Never heard him answer that quickly.
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Tch. Heard that clearly! Fine, I'll be quieter.

Option: [red]Ryoma[/red]: Prisoner? You mean yourself?
Lines: Pael: [thinky_dots]Footsteps... you again... a prisoner can walk... so loudly...[/thinky_dots]
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Prisoner? You mean yourself?
Pael: Trapped here... so long... so long...
[red]Ryoma[/red]: ...Three years. Framed for murder, locked up for three whole years.
Pael: Waiting... for someone to open the door...?
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Waiting? All I thought about was smashing that door down myself!
Pael: You... got out...
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Yeah. So when you say prisoner, I can't just call it sleep talking.
Pael: Then... sit a little longer...

Option: [red]Ryoma[/red]: Won't rush to wake you today.
Lines: [red]Ryoma[/red]: Won't rush to wake you today.
Pael: [thinky_dots]Already... did...[/thinky_dots]
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Tch. Count this one, then.
Pael: Still... angry...?
[red]Ryoma[/red]: At things worth being angry about. No need to shout at you.
Pael: Then... keep it... until I'm awake...
[red]Ryoma[/red]: All right. I'll tell you when you wake. You'd better listen carefully.

Option: [white]Hayato[/white]: Always asleep. Who watches the door for you?
Lines: [white]Hayato[/white]: Always asleep. Who watches the door for you?
Pael: [thinky_dots]You... already checked...[/thinky_dots]
[white]Hayato[/white]: Habit.
Pael: Over there... another place...
[white]Hayato[/white]: Where?
Pael: ...To sit.
[white]Hayato[/white]: ...Hmph. You meant sit down.

Option: [white]Hayato[/white]: You told me to sit last time. I rarely used to leave the command station.
Lines: [white]Hayato[/white]: You told me to sit last time. I rarely used to leave the command station. Commanded a mothership called Tower.
Pael: You... have a tower too...
[white]Hayato[/white]: A ship. I once meant to ram it into the enemy, myself aboard.
Pael: [thinky_dots]Then... no more orders to give...[/thinky_dots]
[white]Hayato[/white]: ...I said it was the only way left.
Pael: Then... what happened...
[white]Hayato[/white]: These two dragged me out.
Pael: They... didn't do as you said...
[white]Hayato[/white]: Fortunately.

Option: [white]Hayato[/white]: Your turn to wake me this time.
Lines: [white]Hayato[/white]: Your turn to wake me this time.
Pael: [thinky_dots]You're... tired too...[/thinky_dots]
[white]Hayato[/white]: Yeah. Just a short rest. People are waiting for orders. Can't oversleep this time.
Pael: How... many times... should I call...
[white]Hayato[/white]: If I don't answer, call again. We had to call you for ages.
Pael: ...Then... take turns...
[white]Hayato[/white]: Hmph. With you as my partner, I won't sleep long.

Option: [yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Wait. Doesn't taking that hurt you?
Lines: Pael: [thinky_dots]Take... a part of me...[/thinky_dots]
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Wait. Doesn't taking that hurt you?
Pael: There's plenty... a little... is fine...
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: I asked if it hurts. Being big doesn't mean you can't feel pain.
Pael: [thinky_dots]...You're not here to pick things...[/thinky_dots]
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: I'll listen first. We can talk about taking things later.

Option: [yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Looking at you reminds me of someone I raised.
Lines: [yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Seeing you always give yourself away reminds me of someone I raised. She can stand on her own now.
Pael: Then... you can sleep...
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Not that easy. Used to wish she'd grow up. Now she has, and I still want to stand in front of her.
Pael: ...Can you stop her...
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: She charges out, and my hand reaches after her. But she can hold her own controls now.
Pael: [thinky_dots]You... can't quite tell either...[/thinky_dots]
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Ha. Time I learned to loosen my grip. That girl's every bit as stubborn as I am.

Option: [yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Who do you want me to visit?
Lines: Pael: Could you... check on my father...
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Who do you want me to visit?
Pael: [thinky_dots]We... cannot choose our family... killing father... won't bring peace...[/thinky_dots]
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: ...You still can't let him go.
Pael: Will you... tell me to...
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Couldn't say that to you. We fathers have things we can't let go of either.
Pael: Then... don't answer yet...
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: All right. You sleep. I'll sit a little longer.
Pael: [thinky_dots]Ryoma... quiet today... Hayato... sit there...[/thinky_dots]
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: What about me?
Pael: You... sleep too...
[red]Ryoma[/red]: All this time, and he hasn't missed anyone.
[white]Hayato[/white]: He remembers people more quietly than you do.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Made it through last time. Today we'll sit a while.
Pael: [thinky_dots]Mm... all your voices... here...[/thinky_dots]
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Not asking what happened up there?
Pael: If you want... tell me... my father...
[white]Hayato[/white]: Then we won't start with the ending.
Pael: [thinky_dots]This time... who needs waking first...[/thinky_dots]
[white]Hayato[/white]: I'm awake. Not finishing last time doesn't mean nobody's on watch now.
[red]Ryoma[/red]: I'm here too.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: All present! Catch our breath first. The rest can wait.
Pael: ...Good...
Pael: Ryoma...
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Awake.
Pael: Hayato...
[white]Hayato[/white]: Also awake.
Pael: Benkei...
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Keep calling, and none of us will get any rest.
Pael: [thinky_dots]...I'll sleep first, then...[/thinky_dots]
Tezcatara: Come in, darling. You burn more beautifully than that armor outside.
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Darling?! Hey, who are you calling that!
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Ryoma, you're shouting the soup out of its bowl.
Tezcatara: And this hungry guest?
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Benkei Kuruma. Ha ha, I didn't say hungry... smells good, though!
[white]Hayato[/white]: Let our host finish, Benkei. Hayato Jin. Thank you for having us.
Tezcatara: One impatient, one hungry, one still watching my hands. Come, there's soup for everyone.

Option: [red]Ryoma[/red]: Hey! Not even one mouthful, and you're telling us to kill?
Lines: Tezcatara: Eat first, darling. You can't slaughter on an empty stomach.
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Hey! Not even one mouthful, and you're sending us to fight?
Tezcatara: But the first half was sound advice.
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Treated other guests this way?
Tezcatara: A little girl. I told her to grow tall and strong.
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Urged her to kill enemies too?
Tezcatara: The soup is still hot, Ryoma. Take your time asking.

Option: [red]Ryoma[/red]: I'm not burning away every bitter memory.
Lines: [red]Ryoma[/red]: I'm not burning away every bitter memory.
Tezcatara: Didn't the last bowl make you feel better?
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Good soup. But those things stay. Burn away every beating I took, and I'll just get beaten the same way again!
Tezcatara: [orange]A fire that looks back.[/orange] Such a difficult flame to feed.
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Too much trouble for you?
Tezcatara: A little. Makes me want to watch all the more.
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Ha! Watch, then! This fire isn't done burning!

Option: [red]Ryoma[/red]: I've had the soup. Time to say who you want dead.
Lines: [red]Ryoma[/red]: I've had the soup. Time to say who you want dead.
Tezcatara: The Architect. I want him dead, Ryoma. That doesn't contradict wanting you well fed.
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Ha! That's honest!
Tezcatara: Then will you tend that fire for me?
[red]Ryoma[/red]: I appreciate the meal. But how we fight is up to me and those other two!
Tezcatara: A flame no hand can hold.
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Try grabbing it. You'll find out how hot it is!
Tezcatara: Heh... put the bowl down first. You're gripping it quite hard enough.

Option: [white]Hayato[/white]: When these things burn out, what's left?
Lines: [white]Hayato[/white]: When these things burn out, what's left?
Tezcatara: Ash, dear. Must you ask even that?
[white]Hayato[/white]: I've seen fine gifts with the cost hidden at the end.
Tezcatara: Then I'll tell you first: even beautiful wax burns out.
[white]Hayato[/white]: At least that's an honest answer.
Tezcatara: Want to write it on every gift?
[white]Hayato[/white]: Saying it first could save a lot of trouble.

Option: [white]Hayato[/white]: This fire reminds me of what happened on the surface.
Lines: Tezcatara: Always watching the fire. Afraid of it? A girl with the Blight once had soup here too.
[white]Hayato[/white]: The Blight? Your illness has something to do with fire?
Tezcatara: I was only warming her, dear. My soup cannot cure everything.
[white]Hayato[/white]: I see. Our world was contaminated by [getter_ray]Getter Rays[/getter_ray]. The survivors hid underground for thirteen years.
Tezcatara: No wonder. You see your own past in this fire.
[white]Hayato[/white]: Different names, different causes. I need to know. Similar suffering doesn't make them the same.
Tezcatara: So the soup must wait?
[white]Hayato[/white]: ...Smells good. One more look at the flue, then I'll sit.

Option: [white]Hayato[/white]: Think it through first this time. Where can everyone retreat?
Lines: Tezcatara: Inspecting the flue again today?
[white]Hayato[/white]: Already did. Your fire has an outlet. Some people light theirs without leaving a way out for anyone.
Tezcatara: Including you?
[white]Hayato[/white]: ...That's why I'll think first this time. How far to use that power, and where everyone can retreat.
Tezcatara: The enemy won't wait until everyone is safely settled.
[white]Hayato[/white]: I know. That's exactly why you think before you strike.
Tezcatara: Sit first, then, commander. At least I haven't blocked the path in front of you.

Option: [yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: That steam takes me back to the surface survey team.
Lines: Tezcatara: You've warmed the bowl with your hands. Still not drinking? Not to your taste today?
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Ah, no. That steam suddenly took me back to the surface survey team.
Tezcatara: Hungry guests as well?
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Those lads following me came alive at mealtime. All bravado before leaving; back home, they wouldn't spare a drop.
Tezcatara: Heh... you filled their bowls too?
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Of course! A trip to the surface was no joke. I worried they weren't getting enough.
Tezcatara: This time, I'm serving. Try it?
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Right! ...Mm. Nothing like a hot meal.

Option: [yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Today's memory gives me even more to worry about.
Lines: Tezcatara: Last bowl brought back your young followers. Who is in your bowl today?
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Ha ha! Someone who gives me even more to worry about. My daughter, Kei.
Tezcatara: She went to the surface with you too?
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Later on. Before that, we had to hide underground. I looked after her under what little light we had.
Tezcatara: How does a child grow up without seeing the sun?
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Meal by meal, day by day. First she clung to me, then before I knew it she was talking back.
Tezcatara: You sound quite happy about that.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Heh! Better enough spirit to argue than cowering in a corner. She used to be called Genki—full of life, just like the name.
Tezcatara: Then have a little more. This bowl is nearly cold.

Option: [yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Get them around the pot again, and we'd never hear the end of it.
Lines: Tezcatara: Your survey team, and Kei. You'd like them to try this soup?
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Sure would. Get them around the pot again, and we'd never hear the end of it.
Tezcatara: Well fed, strong bodies. Then they'll have the strength to kill.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: That last part, I don't like. I want them coming home to fight over dinner, every time they go out.
Tezcatara: To return to the table, they must survive the enemy first.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: ...That's true. So when someone has to stand in front, it'll be me!
Tezcatara: A father who can't sit still. Today, let's fill your bowl first.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Right! Another bowl. Benkei Kuruma won't be shy about dinner today!
Tezcatara: It's been a long time. Three places, and the soup is warm.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: One smell, and I can almost hear those lads making a racket again.
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Your stomach already answered for them.
[white]Hayato[/white]: You didn't arrive a step behind, Ryoma.
Tezcatara: Heh... sit first. There are enough stories for a long stay.
Tezcatara: Reached the top last time? Come, the soup hasn't cooled.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Good! Everyone's here. Let's eat!
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Fill mine! That was one hell of a fight!
[white]Hayato[/white]: Even at dinner, your voice won't take a rest.
Tezcatara: Eat before arguing. My pot doesn't want to be caught between you.
Tezcatara: Still carrying the fire left from last time?
[red]Ryoma[/red]: I am. No need to burn it all away.
[white]Hayato[/white]: We've remembered what we need to.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Eat first! Full bellies, then another charge!
Tezcatara: Heh... that sounds more like me every time.
Tezcatara: Who finds fault first today?
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Not me.
[white]Hayato[/white]: Haven't spoken yet.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Little chip in this bowl.
Tezcatara: ...All right. You.
Nonupeipe: Such a rough yet dazzling visitor. Come, let me lend that ferocity a little splendor.
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Ryoma Nagare. Shin Getter's outside. Who exactly are you dressing up?
Nonupeipe: The three who walked through my door, naturally. Steel must learn to wait outside.
[white]Hayato[/white]: Ryoma, Benkei. Our host seems thoroughly prepared.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: After you, Hayato. With my build, I'd better mind the carpet.
Nonupeipe: Benkei, yes? I heard your companions say it. There's a wider place inside.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Ha! Thank you for having us.

Option: [red]Ryoma[/red]: Noble warrior? Ha, not me.
Lines: Nonupeipe: Come, noble warrior. Let me see what suits you.
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Noble warrior? Ha, not me.
Nonupeipe: So particular about clothing too?
[red]Ryoma[/red]: I don't wear things that don't fit.
Nonupeipe: You haven't tried it yet.
[red]Ryoma[/red]: If wearing it means dying for you, I'd rather go bare-chested!
Nonupeipe: ...Very well. We'll look only at the clothing first.

Option: [red]Ryoma[/red]: People used to be quick to give me names too.
Lines: [red]Ryoma[/red]: Those bastards liked calling me murderer, prisoner, before telling me to obey.
Nonupeipe: So even a compliment makes you bare your teeth.
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Give me a prettier name, and you can lead me around?
Nonupeipe: Certainly not. But assuming I'm here to leash you isn't polite either.
[red]Ryoma[/red]: That's not your plan?
Nonupeipe: I want you to confront the Architect. That doesn't stop me thinking you deserve good clothing.
[red]Ryoma[/red]: ...Good! Now you've said it plainly, I'll look at the clothes.

Option: [red]Ryoma[/red]: No warrior title today. Use my name.
Lines: [red]Ryoma[/red]: No warrior title today. Use my name.
Nonupeipe: Ryoma-san. Does that fit well enough?
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Close enough.
Nonupeipe: Then please sit. That isn't an order.
[red]Ryoma[/red]: I can tell. Thanks.
[white]Hayato[/white]: There's a rarity.
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Would it kill you to keep quiet once?
Nonupeipe: Nothing would happen. But this feels more like three guests.

Option: [white]Hayato[/white]: Hayato Jin. Thank you for the welcome.
Lines: [white]Hayato[/white]: Hayato Jin. Thank you for the welcome.
Nonupeipe: At last, someone willing to accept a proper greeting.
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Since when did you—
[white]Hayato[/white]: Hmph. She treats us courteously. I can return the courtesy.
Nonupeipe: It's been so long since I received visitors. Thousands of years can make one forget many courtesies.
[white]Hayato[/white]: Thousands? Your hospitality hasn't grown rusty.
Nonupeipe: I enjoy speaking with you. Next time, don't speak only for the other two.

Option: [white]Hayato[/white]: Is nobility a compliment, or an obligation that comes with the gift?
Lines: Nonupeipe: Noble warriors should save us. The Architect has gone mad.
[white]Hayato[/white]: Is nobility a compliment, or an obligation that comes with the gift?
Nonupeipe: Must every sentence become a contractual clause?
[white]Hayato[/white]: I want your honest wish. What do you want us to do?
Nonupeipe: Very well. I want you to deal with him.
[white]Hayato[/white]: Understood. I'll remember it. Our answer waits until the three of us discuss it.
Nonupeipe: At least you haven't pretended not to hear.

Option: [white]Hayato[/white]: You give so much. What did you come to the Spire to find?
Lines: [white]Hayato[/white]: You give so much. What did you come to the Spire to find?
Nonupeipe: You've finally asked about me.
[white]Hayato[/white]: Can't only ask about the next jewel.
Nonupeipe: We too left our hiding places for the Spire. Too long without its blessings. Those who give can also lack.
[white]Hayato[/white]: So you have reasons you had to come as well.
Nonupeipe: Surprised? Giving doesn't mean having everything.
[white]Hayato[/white]: No. Hearing you welcome us all this time, I nearly forgot to ask about you.
Nonupeipe: Stay longer next time, Hayato. My turn to speak will come.

Option: [yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Leave me somewhere to sit too.
Lines: Nonupeipe: Give your things to the man behind you, Ryoma.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: I can carry them. Leave me somewhere to sit too.
Nonupeipe: Aren't you the one who looks after them?
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Sure. But Benkei Kuruma came as their companion. He could rest his feet too, couldn't he?
Nonupeipe: An oversight on my part. Benkei, please.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Ha ha, room to breathe! That's a delicate table. I'll mind my hands.

Option: [yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: No need to call someone else. I'll help move it.
Lines: [yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: No need to call someone else. I'll help move it.
Nonupeipe: You just claimed a chair, and you're already up working?
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Sat enough. Lending a hand won't hurt!
Nonupeipe: Always like this?
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Ryoma charges ahead, Hayato's always thinking. If I don't keep an eye out, who calls them home for dinner?
Nonupeipe: You sound accustomed to coming last.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Ha ha! Put me first, and they'll have to watch my back!

Option: [yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: I'd like to sit here today.
Lines: [yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: I'd like to sit here today.
Nonupeipe: The wider armrests? I've kept it for you.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: You remembered.
Nonupeipe: Naturally. Benkei isn't 'the one carrying things'.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Then I'll remember something too. Do you prefer guests praise the clothes first, or the tea?
Nonupeipe: My taste first.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Ha! Saves me guessing!
Nonupeipe: Ryoma, Hayato, Benkei. It's been a while. Your places are unchanged.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Wide armrests too.
[red]Ryoma[/red]: No warrior's hat added either.
[white]Hayato[/white]: Seems I owe you a proper greeting.
Nonupeipe: I'll wait for it. Especially from the guest who knows his manners best.
Nonupeipe: The air of a hard-won victory suits you better than jewels.
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Ha! What fancy praise this time?
Nonupeipe: No. Just this once, I wish to say you fought beautifully.
[white]Hayato[/white]: And your own wish?
Nonupeipe: Still there. Today, my guests come first.
Nonupeipe: You didn't finish last time. Sit first, all three of you.
[red]Ryoma[/red]: No other titles?
Nonupeipe: You've already told me what doesn't fit.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Thanks, then. No need to move the table.
[white]Hayato[/white]: Heh. We can sit comfortably, it seems.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Praise your taste first, right?
Nonupeipe: Well remembered, Benkei.
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Hayato, did you teach him?
[white]Hayato[/white]: He didn't need me for that.
Nonupeipe: See? One of you is willing to learn.
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Ha! You've got us this time.
Neow: [sine]...Awaken... steel from another world...[/sine]
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Don't wake me in that tone.
Neow: [sine]...Three voices... I need only... one blade...[/sine]
[white]Hayato[/white]: Wrong address. Here, you tell all three of us what's happening.
Neow: [sine]...Kill... the Architect...[/sine]
[red]Ryoma[/red]: I'll smash whoever blocks my way. But get this straight, Neow. I'm not your weapon.
Neow: [sine]...Weapons... all say that...[/sine]
[red]Ryoma[/red]: ...You again.
Neow: [sine]...You reached... the end...[/sine]
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Don't need you to tell me.
Neow: [sine]...Yet you... are still here...[/sine]
Neow: [sine]...Well... done... my warrior...[/sine]
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: We win, and suddenly we're your warriors?
[white]Hayato[/white]: Wait for the rest of the sentence.
Neow: [sine]...Once more...[/sine]
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Ha. You called it.
Neow: [sine]...Returned again... three voices... that won...[/sine]
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Coming back to hear you count us. Strange feeling.
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Ha! Three voices, not one missing.
[white]Hayato[/white]: No memories missing either. We know what happened last time.
Neow: [sine]...Then... carry them... upward...[/sine]
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Of course we will! We remember exactly how to fight next time!
Neow: [sine]...The road... unfinished...[/sine]
[red]Ryoma[/red]: I know.
Neow: [sine]...Will you... try again...[/sine]
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Do I look like someone who gives up?
[white]Hayato[/white]: We can't repeat last time's mistake.
[red]Ryoma[/red]: Never said I would.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Let him finish first.
Neow: [sine]...Will you... take the arguing... too...[/sine]
[white]Hayato[/white]: Yes. Better than taking the same mistake up there.
Neow: [sine]...You have... returned...[/sine]
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Yeah. All three of us.
Neow: [sine]...Only... the last stretch... remains...[/sine]
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: Let us catch our breath. Even the toughest man needs that!
